title: SILSA: Sliding-Window Slice Latents for Topology-Preserving High-Resolution 3D Generation
one_line_judgement: 值得先保存：据摘要（arXiv 2610.02201）：SILSA 用 sliding-window slice latents 做 topology-…
one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.02201）：SILSA 用 sliding-window slice latents 做 topology-preserving 高分辨率 3D generation，明确指出'voxel latents + multi-stage pipelines fragment continuous surfaces into many local tokens, inflate generation cost, and weaken topological consistency'，用 compact sliding-window slice latents 解决。是 multimodal-agent × inference-serving × memory 的'sliding-window slice 3D latent'长尾架构资产——'topology-preserving + sliding-window latent'范式可迁移到任意'高分辨率体素生成 / 大 3D scene'子方向；与今日 NEPA 在'diffusion condition design'层面相邻；与昨日 / 上周 multimodal-agent × 3D / world model 主线在'3D generation architecture'层面同源。今日维持长尾卡片。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 sliding-window 协议、slice latent 拼接、topology consistency metric、与现有 voxel latent baseline 对照。
